summary: Cavitation Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive tender offer agreement with European Guarantee Services S.à r.l. to acquire all outstanding common shares for $35 million in cash, net of certain indebtedness and accrued liabilities. The initial offer price equals net price divided by shares outstanding at agreement date, adjusted to a final price at a record date 45 business days after offer commencement. The offer stays open at least 60 business days initially, then 30 days after final price dissemination. Conditions include Purchaser acquiring Cavitation's ~17% stake in Alchemy Beverages Inc. via separate tender, and sufficient tenders. Watch offer price per share, minimum tender condition, and ABI tender completion.
